name: Obico
description: Obico is a self-hosted server for 3D printing monitoring and remote control. It links to OctoPrint or Klipper printers and runs an AI failure-detection model (spaghetti detection) on the webcam stream. Print from anywhere, watch live video, and get notified when a print fails.

notes.text: Log in at http://<IP>:3334/admin with root@example.com / supersecret and change the password immediately.
Point the Obico plugin (OctoPrint) or moonraker-obico (Klipper) at http://<IP>:3334 to link printers.
For Bambuddy's AI failure detection, enter http://<IP>:3333 as the Obico ML URL and the ML_API_TOKEN from /opt/obico/.env.
